question:
Select the most appropriate homonym.

The company refused to **back **the project.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Support)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"back"** in this context means to give support or approval to something. (समर्थन करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The investor decided to back the new startup despite the risks involved.
 
 
 
• **"Support"** refers to providing assistance, encouragement, or approval to someone or something. (सहायता करना/समर्थन)
 
 
• **Example: **Her family supported her decision to pursue her dreams abroad.
 
 
 
• In the given statement, “The company refused to back the project,” the word “back” clearly means support as the company is declining to assist or approve the project.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Support)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Finish **(समाप्त करना): To complete something or bring it to an end.

 
 
• **Example:** She managed to finish the book in just two days.
 
 
 
• **Leave **(छोड़ना): To go away from a place or situation.
 
 
• **Example: **He decided to leave the company after five years of service.
 
 
 
• **Pack** (पैक करना): To put items into a container, especially for transport or storage.
 
 
• **Example:** She started to pack her suitcase for the upcoming trip.
